## Summary

Describe the generator, viewer, exporter, documentation, or release change.

## Validation

- [ ] Dependency-free tests pass.
- [ ] Python compilation passes.
- [ ] QGIS smoke coverage was run or the reason it is unnecessary is documented.
- [ ] User-visible changes are in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] No real grower data, credentials, caches, or private generated outputs are included.
- [ ] Permanent fake-data labeling remains intact.
